policies.shipping: We deliver nationwide across all cities, towns, and tehsils in Pakistan via TCS, Leopard, and CallCourier. Standard delivery time is 2-4 business days for major cities (Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, Peshawar, Quetta) and 3-5 business days for other areas. Express orders are processed same-day before 3:00 PM PST.
policies.returns: Aman Cloth House provides a hassle-free 7-day return and exchange policy. Items must be unused, unwashed, and in original packaging with all tags attached. Made-to-measure and custom-tailored suits cannot be returned unless defective. Return postage is covered by Aman Cloth House in case of damaged or incorrect items.
policies.privacy: Your privacy is paramount. Aman Cloth House protects customer personal contact information and delivery details. We never sell or distribute phone numbers or addresses to third parties. All transactions and online payment channels are encrypted with industry-standard protocols.
policies.terms: By placing an order on Aman Cloth House, you confirm your acceptance of our standard terms. Prices are subject to availability. Order verification calls or WhatsApp confirmations may be conducted prior to dispatch for high-value Cash on Delivery parcels.
policies.about: Founded with a dedication to preserving Pakistan’s rich heritage of master textiles and artisanal embroidery, Aman Cloth House has grown from a prestigious Lahore boutique into a premier nationwide clothing destination. We fuse age-old zardozi, resham threadcraft, and pure natural fabrics with contemporary tailored silhouettes.
